entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Diana, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse you sold me. This is unbelievable.

I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? My preference is for products that work! Look, I don't have time for a 20-question interrogation. Just process the return. I want my money back now, or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Do you understand?
I understand your frustration, and I want to get this sorted out for you quickly. I just need to pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Of course I don't have it handy! Can't you look it up with my phone number? If you can't even do that, I need to speak to your manager immediately.
That's not a problem at all. I can use the number you're calling from. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 25th. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's the one. Now, are you going to give me my money back or am I going to have to file a chargeback with my credit card company?
There's no need for that. Let me just check our return policy... Okay, I see it here. Your purchase was delivered 25 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery.
It means you are well within the return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund. I've just initiated the process now.
Oh. Really? Just like that? You're approving it?

Yes, of course. I've sent a return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well... that was easier than I expected. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
